plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1612–1614 & 23 Jan 1775 (Santorio Santorio invents the scaled clinical mouth thermometer and weighing chair, and Charles Blagden steps into a 126 °C heated room with a raw beefsteak to prove evaporative sweat cooling) · 1866, 1868 & 1912 (Following Allbutt's pocket thermometer, Carl Wunderlich analyses 1,000,000 armpit readings across 25,000 patients in Leipzig to define 37.0 °C, and Henry Barbour discovers the brain's thermostat in the anterior hypothalamus) · 1948 & 1975 (Paul Beeson discovers leukocyte pyrogens that raise the hypothalamic set-point, and Matthew Kluger proves in desert iguanas that fever triples survival against bacterial infection).
